description: A short summary of what changed on a tracker or a whole site over the last days ("this week Notion changed its pricing page twice: Team from $10 to $12 [1, 2]"), written only from Monity Network change records; every sentence cites records listed in citations. text is null when nothing changed or nothing could be said from the records.

days.description: 7 (default) or 30; any other number reads as 7

watch.description: A one-source tracker's slug or id

watchlist.description: A tracker's slug or id, for a tracker with several sources

name: summarize_network_changes
title: Summarise what changed
